02 / The next chapter

A more complete
desktop workspace.

The current development preview brings export, external-change sync, file uploads and in-app update controls into the same place.

Take a copy.HTML, CSV and JSON export are part of this preview’s scope.

Keep in step.External-change polling, a manual refresh and visible sync state.

Bring your files.File uploads use your Raindrop.io account and its plan limits.

Stay in control.Check for app updates and choose when to apply them.

Preview scope, not a release announcement. Check the release notes for verified availability.

Lain is an independent desktop client for Raindrop.io.
A Raindrop.io account and an internet connection are required.

⌘macOSApple Silicon & Intel · check release assets↗⌃Linux x64AppImage & deb · preview target↗

Alpha software. These links open GitHub Releases, not an unverified installer. Linux packages and update support must be confirmed in the selected release.

Before you install

Check your operating system, CPU and the release’s notes. Linux AppImage updates and deb package updates follow different paths. This design preview does not claim a published Linux release, instant sync, offline editing or verified performance.
